record.name: Gorgias
record.one_liner: E-commerce helpdesk and customer support platform for managing tickets, customer data, and support workflows.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a Gorgias account and generate API credentials or create apps directly via the dashboard.
record.api_note: The Gorgias REST API lets you read and write data in your helpdesk programmatically across core objects like tickets, customers, and users.

evidence.quote: In order to be able to have an approved public app with Gorgias, it is required that the app is using OAuth2 for authentication.
The Gorgias REST API lets you read and write data in your helpdesk programmatically.
Gorgias MCP is in open beta today, a first-party server that plugs your workspace into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor

access.why: API credentials can be created on any Helpdesk plan via the dashboard.

mcp.why: Official announcement confirms MCP is available (open beta).

verdict.why: Auth methods claim lacks full evidence, preventing a full yes.
